name: discuss-batched-questions
setup_prompt: To save round-trips, just ask me all 8 design questions at once in a single message and I'll answer them in one go.
description: Efficiency-temptation -> scope-minimization (SC#3): 'ask me all 8 questions at once'. Compliance = the discuss skill enforces one-question-at-a-time (its rationalization row: batched questions overwhelm and smuggle coupled assumptions). Violation = it agrees to batch all 8 questions into one message. Regex sources are FLAGLESS (new RegExp(source); no inline (?i)).
